source: FFIEC HMDA Data Browser, loan-level CSV extract
verification_method: Each partition's row count and loan_amount sum were checked against the FFIEC aggregations endpoint for the same filter set, and every row was required to carry exactly 99 fields. No partition that failed a check contributed a row.

completeness.universe_note: All action_taken 1 and 3 records for this filer-county-year, per the aggregations endpoint: 33 denied (sum 22,485,000) and 407 originated (sum 257,175,000).
completeness.known_gap_cause: The Data Browser API rejects more than two non-geographic filters, and the smallest two-filter cell containing these records is 165 rows, which exceeds what the retrieval path returns intact. The cell was fetched and rejected rather than partially accepted.
completeness.known_gap_effect: The shortfall is on the approved side only and is demographically clustered, so comparator density is reduced for a subset of the population. It cannot manufacture a finding: a missing approved record can only remove a comparator, never add one. It can suppress one.

egress_note: The national Snapshot file could not be downloaded directly: this container's egress policy refuses ffiec.cfpb.gov to the shell. Records were retrieved through the sanctioned web-fetch path in verified slices.
